feature_section_1.title: Co-developing renewable energy projects with communities

items.subtitle: Community-Ferténergie partnership
paragraphs: Your community:
- Has existing or planned roofs suitable for solar installations.
- Is aware of private and business building projects.
- Wants to involve its citizens in an energy transition project.
- Wants to commit to projects with one or more elected officials.

items.subtitle: A structured approach for success
paragraphs: Ferténergie:
- Will provide a pre-assessment of various points to check project feasibility (agreements, insurance issues, loan guarantees, building plans, surrounding works, etc.).
Your community:
- Will need to make appropriate decisions to enable the partnership (making roofs available).
- Can use the project to raise awareness among families, businesses, and children about energy efficiency (positive energy challenge, energy management).

feature_section_2.title: Management and coordination of citizen projects

items.subtitle: Mastering the key stages of project development
paragraphs: A citizen renewable energy project involves several key stages: site identification, feasibility studies, financial planning, local consultation, administrative procedures, and finally commissioning the installation.

items.subtitle: A network of key stakeholders
paragraphs: The success of a project also depends on the right network: local authorities, technical partners, and committed citizens are all essential.

items.subtitle: Identifying and anticipating problems
paragraphs: Anticipating potential difficulties is crucial to ensuring a project's success. Thanks to our experience, we can now identify the main risks from the very first stages.

posts.title: The Ferténergie collective seeks to produce more renewable energy
posts.description: On Saturday morning, the Ferténergie citizen collective (a simplified joint-stock company), which has thirty-four shareholders including the city of La Ferté-Macé, held its general assembly at the Paul-Souvray school, in the presence of José Collado, mayor, and Bruno Auvray, vice-president of Flers Agglo, delegate for energy transition.

posts.title: Ferténergie's initiatives attract interest from other collectives
posts.description: On Saturday, the Ferténergie citizen collective welcomed members of the Synergies collective, which operates in northern Mayenne.

posts.title: The Ferténergie company produces electricity across three sites in La Ferté-Macé
posts.description: Sixteen shareholders attended the general assembly of Ferténergie (SAS), based in La Ferté-Macé (Orne), on Saturday, June 15, 2024.

posts.title: Ferténergie expands renewable energy development
posts.description: Founded in 2017, Ferténergie is a simplified joint-stock company (with shares valued at €105 each) comprising thirty-five partners, dedicated to producing renewable energy across the region.

posts.title: The Ferténergie association deploys photovoltaic systems
posts.description: On Saturday, the Ferténergie association, a simplified joint-stock company (SAS) with thirty-five members, held its general assembly at the Paul-Souvray school, right in front of the courtyard shelter where solar panels have been installed.

posts.title: With Ferténergie, the first solar panels are up and running in Couterne
posts.description: On Wednesday, April 7, 2021, the first solar panels installed on residential properties with the support of Ferténergie were presented in Lignou de Couterne (Orne).

posts.title: With Ferténergie, the sun isn't confined to the bocage countryside
posts.description: Initiated in 2017, the local and renewable energy production project by Ferténergie (SAS), based in La Ferté-Macé in Orne, has successfully materialized with the installation of 47 m² of south-facing solar panels on a building owned by Catherine and Dominique Dupont, residents of Lignou in Couterne, directly across from the chapel.

posts.title: Ferténergie: first solar panels to be installed as early as April
posts.description: On Saturday, about twenty members of the Ferténergie association gathered at the La Ferté-Macé (Orne) town hall to review upcoming solar panel installations and map out the deployment schedule.

posts.title: Ferténergie presents its upcoming initiatives to shareholders
posts.description: On Wednesday evening, February 12, the managers of Ferténergie (SAS) presented their project to about thirty attendees, including current and prospective shareholders.

posts.title: Ferténergie: a community project for renewable energy
posts.description: Supported by the municipality of La Ferté-Macé (Orne), a citizen group is set to deploy 1,000 m² of photovoltaic panels on public buildings through a newly formed simplified joint-stock company.

posts.title: A public meeting for Ferténergie on Wednesday, February 12 in La Ferté-Macé
posts.description: Recently established in La Ferté-Macé (Orne), Ferténergie (SAS) is hosting a public information meeting in the near future to expand its membership.

posts.title: Ferténergie enters its operational phase
posts.description: Come spring, 1,000 m² of solar panels will be installed on the roofs of the municipal restaurant, the Souvray school courtyard shelter, and the Brel middle school gymnasium.

posts.title: Ferténergie bets heavily on solar panels
posts.description: For several months, a local citizen collective has been working to get Ferténergie up and running in La Ferté-Macé. This company aims to foster cleaner energy by supporting property owners with solar panel installations. Here is a breakdown.

about_us.title: Info & Contact
texts: Our goal is to develop photovoltaic projects on both private and public roofs, as well as on available land in the region.

items.subtitle: Creation of SAS Ferténergie
paragraphs: - Initial share capital of €10,100 supported by a management board of 8 members.
- 35 members as of December 6, 2020 with capital of €26,000

items.subtitle: The members
paragraphs: - Subscribe to at least one share of €120.
- Each member has one vote regardless of their shareholding.
- No one can hold more than 20% of the share capital.

items.subtitle: First achievements in 2021

- 81 kWp
- €103k invested
